title: Approximation by a narrow CNF
statement: Let $f:\{−1,1\}^n\to\{−1,1\}$ have a CNF representation with at most $s$ clauses, and let $\varepsilon>0$. There is a sign-valued Boolean function $g$ with a CNF representation of width at most $\left\lceil\log_2(s/\varepsilon)\right\rceil$ such that the relative Hamming distance between $f$ and $g$ is at most $\varepsilon$.
hypotheses_covered: $f$ is a sign-valued Boolean function on $\{−1,1\}^n$
$f$ has a CNF representation with at most $s$ clauses
